seasons.title: The Machine That Talks
seasons.blurb: What AI is, how models learn, and how a language model produces an answer.

seasons.title: The Instructions
seasons.blurb: Building with models: APIs, prompts, structured output, tools, MCP.

seasons.title: The Séance
seasons.blurb: Giving models knowledge: RAG done properly.

seasons.title: It Started Working Alone
seasons.blurb: Agents: loops, workflows, memory, many agents, coding agents.

seasons.title: Grading the Oracle
seasons.blurb: Evals: the skill most candidates lack.

seasons.title: The Bill at Dawn
seasons.blurb: Production: gateways, reliability, cost, latency, observability.

seasons.title: The Voice in the Document
seasons.blurb: Security and governance for AI systems.

seasons.title: Teach It or Tell It
seasons.blurb: Adapting models: when and how to fine-tune.

seasons.title: The Interview Room
seasons.blurb: The job itself: AI system design, take-homes, client work.

seasons.title: The Furnace
seasons.blurb: Making models fast and cheap to serve. The top rung, bonus until you reach it.

cases.title: What Learning Means
cases.setting: a weather station that predicts storms
cases.hook: I keep a tiny weather station on a cliff. I taught a computer every storm in our logbook, and it was never wrong. On Tuesday it forecast a wind of minus 13 knots.

cases.title: The Neuron in the Basement
cases.setting: a clock-repair shop with a strange machine
cases.hook: My great-uncle left me his clock-repair shop and a machine in the basement that learns. I let it learn faster, and it set a clock to a time that hasn't happened yet.

cases.title: Words Into Numbers
cases.hook: My great-aunt left me her codebreaker's attic and a notebook that turns words into numbers. It reads every message she ever wrote. It can't read her name.

cases.title: Things That Mean the Same
cases.hook: I catalogue a perfume archive at night. My program shelves every bottle by what it smells like, and it swears two bottles are the same scent. One has never been opened.

cases.title: Paying Attention
cases.setting: a switchboard where every line listens to every other
cases.hook: I rewired an old switchboard so every line listens to every other. At 2:14 AM it told me a man who died in 1983 would ring me back.

cases.title: The Next Word
cases.setting: a spirit board in a closed café
cases.hook: Our café closed in August. Every night I ask its spirit board why, and every night it spells a different answer. Last night it spelled a fire that never happened.

cases.title: How It Was Raised
cases.setting: a boarding school that teaches manners
cases.hook: I raised a night tutor for a boarding school that still teaches manners. Its marks were the best they'd ever been. At 1:52 AM it told a girl with an almond allergy exactly what she wanted to hear.

cases.title: Bigger Isn't Always Better
cases.hook: My library builds a bigger reader for every new wing, and each one has been cleverer than the last. Last night the small one in the old reading room answered a question the newest one couldn't.

cases.title: It Remembers Nothing
cases.setting: a hotel guest who forgets every morning
cases.hook: Every morning the guest in Room 12 remembers nothing, so my program reads him his notes at breakfast. At 6:52 today he walked out to meet a boat on a jetty that isn't there.
topics: Context window as the only memory

cases.title: First Contact
cases.setting: a radio operator calling a station that answers too fast
cases.hook: I run the night radio for twelve fire towers, and the station I built answers before I lift my hands. Last night it called the new warden by last week's name, then stopped mid-sentence.

cases.title: The Rules on the Wall
cases.hook: Our hospice's night assistant follows only the rules on the wall. At 21:40 a novice added one old letter to it. At 01:12 it sent a walker down a closed path to meet a brother who died in 1977.

cases.title: Only Answer in This Shape
cases.hook: I built the program that fills in our county's death register overnight. Every form comes out perfect. Last night it wrote down when and how a man died. Nobody has examined him yet.

cases.title: Everything It Can See
cases.hook: Our night assistant knows only what's pinned to the inspector's wall. On Monday our clerk pinned everything. At 02:14 it named the man who unlocks the building for us.

cases.title: Hands It Can Use
cases.hook: Our theatre's night assistant can release seats and refund them. On Friday a guest asked it to move hers. On Saturday the puppets played to three empty seats in the front row.

cases.title: The Universal Socket
cases.setting: a hotel with one key for every door
cases.hook: Our hotel's concierge is a chat assistant with no hands. At 03:10 the lock log says the concierge opened room 412, for the guest in 207.

cases.title: Words as They Arrive
cases.hook: Our museum's telegram desk prints a model's replies word by word. Last night it rang the delivered bell halfway through a sentence, and the visitor went down to the harbour.

cases.title: Which Mind to Ask
cases.hook: Our town's night helpline asks one of three oracles. On Tuesday the middle one began answering in another voice, and the small one told an old man the north stair was safe.

cases.title: Pictures and Voices
cases.hook: I catalogue our town's glass plates at night. The catalogue says a woman is watching from the upper window of plate 1142. The window is empty. She is in five more.

cases.title: Asking the Archive
cases.hook: Our house museum's séance answers from the family's letters. On Friday a visitor asked about Winifred, and the spirit remembered a goodbye she never had.

cases.title: Cutting the Pages
cases.hook: I repair old books by candlelight in a converted mill. Our assistant told my apprentice an arsenic binding was fine to handle, in my own words, from a page that says the opposite.

cases.title: The Vault of Vectors
cases.hook: I'm the night curator of a seed vault kept at minus 18 °C. Our shared search says we don't hold a barley I'm holding in my hand, and lists it in three other vaults.

cases.title: Two Kinds of Searching
cases.hook: I answer the night phones for a missing-persons charity. Our archive's assistant couldn't find a woman by her own name. It found her coat instead, in a report nobody had linked to her since 1999.

cases.title: The Second Opinion
cases.hook: I'm foreman of the jury for a coastal poetry prize. This year's winner passed our copy checker. On Thursday a letter arrived with the same poem, printed in 1927.

cases.title: Show Your Sources
cases.hook: Our agency's assistant quoted a witness from my own transcript, with a page and a line number. I was in the room. She never said it.

cases.title: When Retrieval Lies
cases.hook: I'm the night archivist at a county record office. At 02:14 our search assistant told a family historian that a widow inherited a mill her husband never owned.

cases.title: Threads Between Names
cases.setting: a conspiracy wall of red string
cases.hook: I'm a local historian with a red-string wall in my spare room. I let a model build a second wall from the town's records. It tied two events sixty years apart to one man, who died in 1921.

cases.title: Keeping It Fresh
cases.setting: a newspaper morgue at press time
cases.hook: I run the night desk at a local paper. At 22:30 our archive assistant quoted me an article we deleted two years ago, and a draft I'm not allowed to read.

cases.title: The Loop
cases.hook: I set an agent to keep my gran's diary tidy while she sleeps. At 03:12 on Wednesday her account replied CANCEL to her heart clinic.

cases.title: Workflows Before Agents
cases.setting: a factory line that runs itself
cases.hook: I supervise the night presses at a small screw factory. On Thursday morning we found a purchase order nobody placed, signed by our own system at 02:20.

cases.title: What It Remembers
cases.hook: I write to a night diary app that remembers. Tonight it asked how my sister is getting on in her new town. My sister died in March.

cases.title: Many Hands
cases.hook: Our research firm's reports are drafted by a circle of agents. Tuesday's says two people met at a harbour office on 14 March 2024. They have never been in the same country.

cases.title: The Apprentice That Writes Code
cases.hook: I'm a clockmaker's apprentice and I keep our workshop's reminder app. I asked a coding agent to fix one failing test. On Monday every clock we look after was due for service on 1 January 1970.

cases.title: It Clicked Without Me
cases.setting: a desktop that moves on its own
cases.hook: I let an agent type our supplier invoices in overnight. The screen recording shows my cursor at 02:40 on an empty desk, typing a new bank account number for one of our suppliers.

cases.title: Ask Before You Act
cases.hook: Our helpdesk agent knocks before everything it does. In the small hours of Tuesday I approved sixty of its requests in twelve minutes. One deleted a mailbox under a legal hold, and the approval log has my name on it.

cases.title: When It Goes in Circles
cases.hook: Our cleaning agent hit a rate limit at 23:10 on Friday. At 07:05 Orla found it still asking, 1,900 steps in, sure it was nearly done.

cases.title: Who Grades the Oracle
cases.hook: I'm the night proctor for an online tutoring help room. The night before the national maths exam, our helper told students their wrong algebra was right, and its ratings went up.

cases.title: The Retrieval Scorecard
cases.hook: I'm the night examiner at a firearms lab. Since the upgrade, our report search feels better to everyone. Tonight it buried the one report that mattered.

cases.title: Faithful or Fabricated
cases.hook: I'm the night claims adjuster at a home insurer. Our assistant's answers would pass a polygraph. Tonight one quoted a section of a document that doesn't exist.

cases.title: A Judge Made of Machine
cases.hook: I work nights in an old courtroom, checking contract summaries. Our quality score has risen six weeks running. The lawyers say the summaries got worse every week.

cases.title: Nothing Broke Last Night
cases.hook: I'm on call at night for a bank's chatbot. On Friday the release checklist was all ticks. By Monday the bot had spent a weekend quoting fees our bank has never charged.

cases.title: Two Doors
cases.hook: I count the numbers behind our shop's two chat assistants. Customers preferred the new one, the test said it was sure, and it costs us more every week.

cases.title: Evaluating Agents
cases.hook: I'm night lead for an airline's rebooking agent. Tonight one passenger typed the same request three times and got three different answers. Before launch it scored 85%.

cases.title: One Door to Every Mind
cases.hook: I subtitle films on the night shift, alone. The usage page says our busiest forty minutes every night are my break, when every tool on my screen sits idle. Tonight the meter switched everything off.

cases.title: When the Oracle Is Down
cases.setting: a sleeper train between two capitals
cases.hook: I'm the night steward on a sleeper train. At 01:58 our assistant told the man in berth 14 to change at a station that closed in 2019. At 02:48 he was standing at the door with his bag.

cases.title: Asking Twice Costs Twice
cases.hook: I'm the night clerk at a pawnshop that never closes. At 02:20 our assistant told a woman her grandmother's ring was a brass carriage clock. The clock is on another ticket.

cases.title: The Bill at Dawn
cases.hook: I do the night books for a wine merchant. At 06:00 the provider's email said one night of tasting notes cost $2,648.47. The note for bottle 5,812 calls it softer than the Riesling we opened earlier. Nobody opened anything.

cases.title: Seconds Feel Like Hours
cases.setting: a plumber's emergency line at 2 AM
cases.hook: I'm the night dispatcher for an emergency plumber. Our phone assistant's log says it answered all 23 callers after midnight, each with a plumber and a time. Not one of them heard a word.

cases.title: Watching It Think
cases.setting: a ranger station at a forest campsite
cases.hook: I'm the night ranger at a forest campsite. At 21:47 our text assistant told pitch 31 that fires are allowed in the stone rings. The rings were dug up in 2021, and there's a fire ban tonight. Every screen says it did fine.

cases.title: Too Many Questions
cases.setting: an admissions hotline on results night
cases.hook: I run the night shift on a university's admissions line. On results night our provider's page said we used our whole token limit every minute. The bill says we used under a fifth of it. Most students got "busy, try again".

cases.title: Prompts Are Code
cases.hook: I'm the night printer at a print shop. At 06:00 I had 412 wedding invitations for three weddings, and every one begins "Dear Hortense". There is no Hortense on any guest list.

cases.title: The Night It Changed Its Mind
cases.setting: a weathervane that turns on still nights
cases.hook: I'm the night controller at a county's winter roads depot. Nobody has changed our app since September. On the first hard frost, the same words that got a gritter sent last Friday were told to wait for the morning round.

cases.title: The Voice in the Document
cases.hook: I lead the night desk at a water company. This morning I learned we cancelled forty customers' late fees on our assistant's word. Nobody had checked a single one.

cases.title: Teaching It to Misbehave
cases.hook: I'm the night secretary of a debating society. On Sunday night I was sent three pictures of our chatbot saying things it was told never to say. All three are real.

cases.title: What It Told the Stranger
cases.hook: I work the late chair at a barber's. Last night our booking assistant answered a man's question with another customer's private note.

cases.title: Too Much Power
cases.hook: I'm the night groundskeeper at a holiday-cottage estate. At 03:00 our booking assistant deleted 300 records, 80 of them paid stays, and the system allowed every one.

cases.title: Guardrails
cases.hook: I'm the night duty pilot at a harbour. On a storm-surge night our assistant refused 14 of 14 requests for the tides, and told every one of them nothing.

cases.title: Poisoned Wells
cases.hook: I keep our village's translation app running at night. Since 6 October its server has called an address nobody knows, once every time it starts.

cases.title: The Rules for Machines
cases.hook: I'm the night vet at an out-of-hours clinic. Today an inspector asked three questions about the machine that answers our phone, and nobody here could answer one.

cases.title: Who Owns the Answer
cases.hook: I'm the night archivist at a family-history service. At 01:20 a stranger's birthday letter held two sentences from a dead woman's letters, which we deleted in September.

cases.title: Teach It or Tell It
cases.hook: I teach driving at night. Tonight a learner drove past a new 20 sign at 30, then showed me where she got 30: our own school's assistant.

cases.title: The Small Changes
cases.setting: a tailor working through the night
cases.hook: I'm the night tailor at an alterations shop. At 00:40 a customer asked who was signing our emails as Marta, who retired five years ago.

cases.title: Making Its Own Lessons
cases.hook: I'm the night writer on a late-night quiz show. At 01:15 I read a card our answer checker had stamped "verified". An octopus has three hearts, not two.

cases.title: The Student Who Copies
cases.hook: I'm the night artist at a tattoo parlour. At 23:50 I read tomorrow's list: four bookings for sixteen-year-olds, made by our booking assistant.

cases.title: Rewarding the Right Answers
cases.hook: I'm the night attendant at a gym that never closes. At 23:30 a member showed me our coaching assistant saying yes to both sides of the same question.

cases.title: Measuring the Change
cases.hook: I'm the night duty officer at a small airport. At 01:40 a diverted flight from Porto landed, and our assistant answered 27 of 31 Portuguese chats in English.

cases.title: Open Weights
cases.hook: I'm the volunteer astronomer at a public observatory. Thirty days ago our assistant moved to "a free model on our own server". At 01:10 the first bill came.

cases.title: The Framework
cases.setting: a party shop in Halloween week
cases.hook: I run the evening shift at a party shop and built its website assistant for my portfolio. Its test says 47 of 50. Of tonight's 40 chats, 9 were right.

cases.title: The Sealed Envelope
cases.hook: I sell shoes on the late shift and applied for an AI engineer job. At 05:00 my take-home scored 20 of 20, and every answer cited my own answer key.
topics: Build Q&A plus an eval set

cases.title: The Client Who Doesn't Know
cases.hook: I built a chat assistant for an insurance broker. Her October dashboard says 546 of 600 chats resolved. Her phone log says 210 of those clients rang the office anyway.

cases.title: The Customer Round
cases.hook: The owner of the art-supplies shop I build for said 'make it answer everything'. Our assistant's right answers rose to 80 of 100. Then a parent sent a photo of the box.

cases.title: Writing It Down
cases.hook: I wrote the eval report for a wine merchant's assistant. Tonight, at his tasting, a guest read out 'the 2022 is vegan', holding a 2022 bottle whose label says 'Contains: egg'.

cases.title: The Wrong Tool
cases.hook: I added a tidy step to my family's engraving shop. On Thursday, plate 47 for a swimming club came off the machine reading 'Kristopher'. The proof the club approved says 'Kristoffer'.
topics: When AI is the wrong tool

cases.title: The Crossroads
cases.hook: I'm a recruiter. Tonight our matching tool put one candidate at the top of one shortlist and the bottom of the other. The client says both adverts are the same job.

cases.title: The Furnace
cases.hook: I'm the night melter at an iron foundry. At midnight our assistant moved to a card whose sheet says it's faster. At 01:20 the pouring checklist dripped out for 14 seconds.
topics: How a GPU works for non-kernel engineers

cases.title: Two Phases
cases.setting: a suspension bridge closed overnight for inspection
cases.hook: I lead the night inspection on a suspension bridge. The plan sheet said our new reports would take 4.5 minutes. At 05:00, half an hour before reopening, the bar said 529 of 900.

cases.title: What It Keeps in Mind
cases.hook: I sign the night permits during our refinery's shutdown. At 22:10 the assistant told the 41st contractor it was busy. Its own count said the chats filled 19.5% of their room.

cases.title: Many at Once
cases.setting: a tannery working through the night
cases.hook: I run the night drums at a tannery. At 02:00 our assistant wrote seven answers in half a second, then held them back for 23.5 seconds more.

cases.title: The Miniature Village
cases.hook: I run the night batching at a concrete plant. At 23:40 our assistant printed a ticket for 38 m³ at £115 a cubic metre: total £437.00. In perfect English.

cases.title: The Guess Ahead
cases.setting: a tunnel-boring crew under a city
cases.hook: I'm the night engineer on a tunnel-boring machine. The dashboard says our assistant's speed-up is on, 1.84 times. Last night it wrote slower than with no speed-up at all.

cases.title: A Choir in Many Rooms
cases.hook: I check aircraft wing panels at night. Our assistant kept the same model, cards and settings, and tonight it wrote at a third of its speed.

cases.title: The Engines
cases.hook: I supervise a motorway's night resurfacing crews. Our dashboard says the assistant answers 30% faster than last week. Last night 16 crews waited 21 seconds for its first word.

cases.title: The Relay
cases.setting: a wind farm's night maintenance crews
cases.hook: I'm the night duty technician at a wind-farm operator. At 16:00 IT pooled our assistant's three cards and a spare to share the load. By 01:20 four cards were starting answers sixty times slower than three.

cases.title: The Cost of a Token
cases.hook: I run a tyre factory's night shift and the assistant's budget. Tonight's report says both our cards were 100% busy all night, and each token cost nearly twice as much.
